svg.aria-label: Two pipelines. Live action: script, then the shoot, then the edit; the dialogue changes during the shoot and the edit. Animation: script, then story reels with temporary voices, where the rewriting happens; then the real voices are recorded; then the scenes are animated, and by then a changed line means re-animating a scene that took months.
svg.text: Shoot first, edit later: the words keep changing to the end.
Edit first, shoot later: the rewriting happens in the story reels.
Once a scene is animated, changing a line means animating it again.
